description: This Java source file defines the class GatewayRequest, which encapsulates a payment request to the eWay payment gateway. It includes fields for transaction details, request URLs, and methods for constructing XML payloads, as well as handling different request types like real-time, CVN, Beagle, and refunds.

classes.name: GatewayRequest
classes.description: A class representing a payment request to the eWay gateway, with methods and fields to manage transaction data, request URLs, and XML serialization.

methods.name: getUrl
methods.description: Returns the appropriate request URL based on the request method and test mode settings.

methods.name: toXml
methods.description: Generates the XML string representation of the payment request, including conditional fields based on request type.

methods.description: Helper method to create an individual XML node string with a given name and value.
